subject: Post-demo: Consensus roadmap, financial gating & legal checklist
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Nunez <alex.nunez@edgestream.io>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: Consensus roadmap, financial gating & legal checklist

Hi Alex — great to run through the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on decision criteria and gating items for procurement/legal: 

1) Decision criteria we heard today
   - Accuracy on entity extraction at 95%+ on your sample set
   - Sub-200ms p95 generation for the 1–2k token patterns you showed
   - Clear data residency + KMS controls for logs and KV cache

2) Procurement/legal asks you mentioned
   - SOC 2 + data processing addendum
   - Standard security scoping: SSO (SAML/OAuth), KMS integration, and retention policy

3) Economic owner / pricing path
   - If you can intro the economic buyer / finance reviewer, we’ll send a one-page ROI snapshot plus banded pricing to speed review.

Attachments: redwood-econ-snapshot.pdf (one-pager ROI), security-scope.xlsx (scoping checklist), MVP-demo-recording.mp4 (demo recording)

Suggested next steps:
- Intro to procurement + legal (if possible this week)
- 30–45m scoping call (security engineer + procurement) to lock the SSO/KMS checklist
- I’ll follow up with a short internal-sell email Naomi can use with execs

Would Friday 12/3 at 10am PT for a procurement scoping call work for you?

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

From: Alex Nunez <alex.nunez@edgestream.io>

Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:05:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Consensus roadmap, financial gating & legal checklist

Thanks Marcus — really helpful summary. High level notes from my side:

- We're interested in the latency profile you showed; final decision will land with Finance but Security/Legal have hard gates.
- Procurement ownership (copied) is procurement@edgestream.io — can someone from your side loop in the pricing/ops contact?
- On security: SSO is SAML 2.0 (Okta), we use AWS KMS for key management. We need an initial answers doc about where logs are stored and whether any customer data is persisted outside KV cache.

Can you send a pricing band (starter / scale / enterprise) and a one-page ROI that I can hand to our CFO? Also please include a short blurb Naomi can use internally.

Friday 12/3 10am PT should work for the procurement scoping call — tentatively pencil us in.

— Alex

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Nunez <alex.nunez@edgestream.io>, Procurement Team <procurement@edgestream.io>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 13:45:27 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Consensus roadmap, financial gating & legal checklist

Thanks Naomi — see updates below and a short internal-sell blurb you can use. I updated the ROI numbers after re-running on the sample data Alex shared.

Updated bullets for CFO note:
- Estimated cost delta: ~$0.12 per 1k tokens (30% cheaper than current baseline) at 1M tokens/month usage — conservative estimate; detailed calc in attached redwood-econ-snapshot.pdf
- Payback window: 6–8 months assuming 1.2M tokens/month initial usage and typical growth curve

Security quick answers (Ben):
- SSO: Full SAML 2.0 support; Okta integration tested in our private deployments. We support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows.
- KMS: We integrate with customer-managed AWS KMS for encryption of persisted artifacts; ephemeral KV cache is cleared per retention policy and not exported by default.
- Logs: Application logs can be routed to customer VPC endpoints; we provide redact-by-rule and configurable retention. Detailed answers in security-scope.xlsx (attached).

Internal-sell email (one paragraph):
Hi team — we completed a targeted demo with EdgeStream showing a 30%+ unit-cost improvement and sub-200ms p95 for their core workflows. Redwood supports Okta SAML and customer-managed KMS; we also offer a private VPC deployment for full data isolation. I'd like to schedule a brief scoping call with procurement and security this week to validate a standard commercial path and get a draft PO in place.

Next actions:
- Marcus to share ROI PDF and demo recording (attached) — done
- Naomi to send internal note to EdgeStream execs — pending
- Set procurement scoping call: Friday 12/3 10:00am PT (tentative)

Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-econ-snapshot.pdf, security-scope.xlsx, MVP-demo-recording.mp4

- Please include a security engineer from your team for the scoping call to confirm SSO/KMS specifics.
- We need a short one-page answer doc to the question: "Will any customer data be exported to third-party systems?" with details on retention and redaction.
- Confirm the 12/3 10:00am PT slot and add a calendar invite (we're good to move forward if procurement gets comfortable).

I've attached: edgestream_po_template.docx (explicitly not included in Redwood attachments list here) — procurement team will share formally.

See you Friday — Alex
